items.description: রয়টার্স-ইপসোস জরিপে দেখা যায়, মূল্যস্ফীতি ও জ্বালানির দাম বৃদ্ধিতে ভোটাররা হতাশ। ডেমোক্র্যাটরা কংগ্রেসের প্রতিনিধি পরিষদের নিয়ন্ত্রণ নিতে পারে বলে বিশ্লেষকেরা মনে করছেন।

items.title: Dollar edges up as oil, gas import payments mount
items.description: The US dollar rose slightly against the taka yesterday as banks faced mounting pressure to settle letters of credit (LCs) for oil and gas imports.

items.title: State banks get MDs from private sector after 20 years
items.description: The government has appointed private-sector executives to lead Janata and Agrani banks for the first time in 20 years, following a recent relaxation of eligibility criteria for chief executives of state-owned lenders.

items.title: First round of FTA talks with Malaysia starts today
items.description: Bangladesh and Malaysia will begin negotiations for a free trade agreement (FTA) in Dhaka today as Bangladesh seeks to secure preferential market access after its graduation from the least developed country (LDC) category.

items.title: Foreign loan disbursements fall 42% in Jul-Sept
items.description: Bangladesh received about half of the $1.27 billion in foreign loan commitments in the first quarter of the 2026-27 financial year, according to provisional data released by the Economic Relations Division (ERD) yesterday.
